seoTitle: NYCPS Calendar 2026-2027: Start Date, Holidays, Recess & PDF
seoDescription: View the NYCPS 2026-2027 school calendar with first day, last day, holidays, winter recess, midwinter recess, spring recess, parent-teacher conferences, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: New York City Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year on September 10, 2026 and ends on June 28, 2027. Winter Recess runs December 24, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Midwinter Recess runs February 15-19, 2027, and Spring Recess runs April 22-30, 2027. Election Day on November 3, 2026 is listed as remote instruction for all students. The NYCPS calendar also includes Regents Administration windows, parent-teacher conference dates, clerical days, and staff development days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does NYCPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: New York City Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year on Thursday, September 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is NYCPS Winter Recess in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs Thursday, December 24, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is NYCPS Midwinter Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Midwinter Recess runs Monday, February 15 through Friday, February 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is NYCPS Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Thursday, April 22 through Friday, April 30, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Is NYCPS in session on Election Day 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official NYCPS calendar lists Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, as remote instruction for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for NYCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for students is Monday, June 28, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in NYCPS 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: NYCPS schedules 180 instructional days for students in the 2026-2027 school year.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the longest NYCPS school break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess and Spring Recess are the longest planned NYCPS breaks in the 2026-2027 calendar, with each spanning seven scheduled weekdays without in-person classes.

calendarFaqs.q: When should NYC families start planning summer vacation?
calendarFaqs.a: Families usually plan summer vacation around the last student day, Monday, June 28, 2027, but should confirm school-specific schedules, graduation events, summer programs, and any updated NYCPS notices before booking travel.

customSections.label: Key Things Families Should Know About NYCPS 2026-2027
customSections.content: The 2026-2027 NYCPS calendar has several dates that are especially important for family planning across New York City.

groups.label: Dates that affect most families
items: The school year begins on Thursday, September 10, 2026, which is later than many large U.S. school districts.
Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, is listed as remote instruction for all students rather than a full school closure.
Winter Recess covers the New Year holiday period from December 24, 2026 through January 1, 2027.
Midwinter Recess runs February 15-19, 2027, creating a full February school-week break.
Spring Recess runs April 22-30, 2027 and is one of the longest planned breaks of the year.
The last day for students is Monday, June 28, 2027.

groups.label: Dates that may vary by school level
items: Parent-teacher conference dates are separated for elementary, middle, high school, K-12, 6-12, and District 75 schools.
Some parent-teacher conference dates include three-hour early dismissal for affected students.
Regents Administration windows mainly affect high school students and may not change schedules for every grade.
Charter, private, parochial, NYCEEC, and Family Childcare programs may follow different calendars.

customSections.label: NYCPS Calendar Download Options
customSections.content: Use the NYCPS calendar tools to view the official PDF, download a printable PDF, import the ICS calendar into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar, save major recess periods, and share school closures with family members. Always verify final schedule changes with the official New York City Public Schools calendar source before making critical plans.

customSections.label: NYCPS Calendar Planning Guide for Families
customSections.content: Use the longest recess periods, remote instruction days, early dismissals, and school-level conference dates to plan childcare, travel, transportation, and work schedules.

groups.label: Childcare planning
items: Thanksgiving Recess, Winter Recess, Midwinter Recess, and Spring Recess are the main multi-day breaks when many families need full-day childcare.
Three-hour early dismissal conference dates can create afternoon coverage needs even when school is open for part of the day.
June 8, 2027 is a clerical day with no classes for 3-K, Pre-K, elementary, middle, K-12, and standalone District 75 students.

groups.label: Travel planning
items: Winter Recess and Spring Recess are the longest uninterrupted breaks on the published NYCPS calendar.
Midwinter Recess creates a full February week without classes for families planning local or out-of-city travel.
Families should avoid booking nonrefundable travel solely from this reference page; confirm the official NYCPS source and school-specific notices first.

groups.label: Work schedule planning
items: Check early dismissal dates by school level before arranging pickup or work coverage.
Treat Regents windows as high school planning dates, especially for students taking January or June exams.
Confirm whether remote instruction, staff development, clerical days, and school-level events affect your child's specific program.

customSections.label: Longest NYCPS Breaks in 2026-2027
customSections.content: The longest planned breaks are useful for families comparing vacation windows, shared custody schedules, and childcare needs.

rows: Covers Christmas week and New Year's Day, with seven scheduled weekdays without classes.
Creates another seven-weekday break later in the school year, often used for travel or childcare planning.

yearNumbers.label: Instructional Calendar Structure
yearNumbers.detail: NYCPS schedules the standard 180 instructional days across a school year that runs from September 10, 2026 through June 28, 2027.

yearNumbers.label: Conference Structure
yearNumbers.detail: Parent-teacher conference dates are separated for elementary and Pre-K, middle and District 75, and high school or 6-12 school communities.

yearNumbers.label: High School Exam Windows
yearNumbers.detail: Regents Administration windows appear in January and June, so high school families should confirm exam schedules with their school.
